name: Augusta
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Augusta?
answer_short: PTVs only on streets Augusta designates: a downtown area and a few named streets on the west side. Downtown streets that are not in the named list stay red on this map. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less in Augusta.

rules.rule: J. Dewey Gray Circle, Wainbrook, Devore Place, part of Interstate Parkway, Heath Drive, and Pine Needle Road, plus the downtown area except listed bans
Registered LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; they may cross faster roads at intersections

banned_roads.name: 15th Street, Walton Way, Gordon Highway, Laney Walker Boulevard
banned_roads.rule: No PTVs in the downtown area

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Augusta?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Not on the interstates. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a PTV on Walton Way in downtown Augusta?
faq.a: No. Augusta bans PTVs on Walton Way, 15th Street, Gordon Highway, and several other downtown streets.

faq.q: Can I drive a PTV on every downtown street?
faq.a: The ordinance allows streets inside the downtown boundary except the named bans. Those extra streets are not digitized, so this map keeps them red.
